question: Which source identities, animal coverage and matrix scales permit bounded Nb5 reproduction and exploratory branches?
decision: Qualify each downstream stage from exact deposited mouse, age, sex, tissue and assay identities; hold unsupported comparisons.
strongest_rival: Cell counts or libraries could be mistaken for independent animals; normalized matrices and changed releases could be mistaken for raw counts and the final paper release.
discriminator: Exact source-table to observation joins, unique mouse identity consistency and whole-matrix nonnegative/integer and deposited-total checks distinguish supported inputs from gaps.
exposure_record: Paper, owner note, source-code descriptions, file schema and supplementary header labels were inspected before freezing. No biological gene contrasts or per-mouse outcomes were computed. Future source work remains exposed.
biological_unit: Deposited original mouse; identity and repeated tissue/assay mapping are evaluated rather than assumed.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells, plates, tissues and assays may share mouse IDs; original Tabula Muris contributes reused young data. No external replication is claimed.
population_and_selection: All deposited observations in the five explicitly downloaded Figshare version-2 objects, plus supplementary source tables. No phenotype-based filtering. Also include every observation in the pinned author Figure 4 brain object; do not treat overlapping cells as additional replication.
contrast: Source identity and measurement-scale concordance only, without a gene-level or population hypothesis test.
endpoint: Cell and animal coverage, identity conflicts, design support, workbook schemas, raw-versus-normalized scale diagnostics and source-table count differences.
methods: Decode legacy AnnData categories with bounds checks; require unique cell indices; group deposited metadata without imputation; inspect all sparse matrix values for count-scale eligibility and compare row sums to n_counts; left-join source Table 1a or 2a by mouse, age, sex, tissue and assay. Inventory supplement schemas without interpreting expression or sequence outcomes. Version 2 expands only explicit merged-cell ranges in supplementary Tables 1a/2a; rows with no tissue are structural totals/separators.
missingness_and_exclusions: No biological observations are excluded. Missing identities and source joins remain explicit. Conflicting categorical codes or nonunique observation IDs stop execution; inconsistent mouse age/sex is exported and blocks downstream inference.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests; counts and file-schema checks only.
precision_basis: Source qualification supplies unit counts but no effect-size margin, variance or confirmatory sample-size justification.
interpretation_limit: Metadata and arithmetic concordance cannot establish independence beyond the documented mouse mapping, causal ageing, lineage, senescence, secretion, functional repair or scientific acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop on malformed identifiers or matrices. Hold any downstream comparison lacking consistent source identities, appropriate scale or estimable design; preserve source-release mismatches rather than silently reconciling them.
amendment_reason: Prospectively qualify the author Figure 4 object containing 18-month brain observations absent from the general release. v2 succeeded; retain it as the original five-object audit. New object schema only was inspected; no gene or cluster age endpoints viewed.
